content: For a dashboard that is primarily server-to-client push (sensor readings, alerts, CV results) with occasional client actions handled fine over normal REST POST, Server-Sent Events (SSE) over plain HTTP is the pragmatic 2025/2026 recommendation -- simpler server code, built-in reconnection, works over standard HTTPS/proxies, no extra library needed. WebSockets (via Socket.IO) are justified only if true low-latency bidirectional interaction is needed (e.g. live manual actuator jog controls) -- Socket.IO adds automatic reconnection/fallback/rooms on top of raw ws.
